set.body:
Qualify a separately configured federation client. Pin POST /datasets request and response shapes. Use only approved outbound researcher-entered filters and configured destinations. Report per-node failure and partial results. Keep external references distinct from accepted local releases and file access. Exercise timeout and base-service operation with the extension disabled. This is independent of the WP-16 publication exit.

Source: docs/implementation-plan.md, External discovery through Neurobagel.
set.title: NB04: Add optional read-only Neurobagel federation search
